schritt-viertakt.einzeln: In walk, the horse puts each hoof down on its own. Count along: one, two, three, four.
schritt-viertakt.reihenfolge: First the left hind, then the left fore. Then the right hind, and then the right fore.
schritt-viertakt.boden: There are always two or three hooves on the ground. That's why the walk has no moment of suspension.
schritt-viertakt.ruhig: That's what makes the walk so calm and comfortable. It is the slowest gait.
schritt-viertakt.merke: Remember: the walk has four beats – one, two, three, four.

trab-zweitakt.paare: In trot, two legs always move at the same time: one foreleg and the hind leg on the opposite side.
trab-zweitakt.diagonal: Left hind moves with right fore, right hind with left fore. These are called diagonal pairs.
trab-zweitakt.takt: Listen to the rhythm: ta-tum, ta-tum. Those are the two beats.
trab-zweitakt.schwebe: Between the beats, the horse floats for a split second. No hoof is touching the ground.
trab-zweitakt.spueren: That's why you feel an up-and-down movement in the saddle.
trab-zweitakt.merke: Remember: the trot is a two-beat gait with diagonal pairs and a short moment of suspension.

richtiger-fuss.seiten: In the arena, there's an inside and an outside. The inside is the side towards the middle, the outside is the side towards the fence.
richtiger-fuss.hand: On the left rein, your left is the inside and your right is the outside.
richtiger-fuss.sitzen: You sit as the inside hind leg and the outside foreleg touch the ground …
richtiger-fuss.aufstehen: … and you rise as those two legs swing forward.
richtiger-fuss.schulter: To check, take a quick glance – just with your eyes – at the outside shoulder. If it's moving forward, you should be up.
richtiger-fuss.wechsel: When you change the rein, inside and outside swap over. So you sit for one extra beat: sit – sit – up.
richtiger-fuss.merke: Remember: outside shoulder forward – you're up. When you change the rein, sit twice.

galopp-dreitakt.takte: In canter, you hear three beats and then a short pause: ba-da-boom, ba-da-boom.
galopp-dreitakt.reihenfolge: In right canter, the left hind leg lands first. Then the right hind and the left fore together. And last of all, the right fore.
galopp-dreitakt.schwebe: Then the horse flies through the air for a moment. That's the moment of suspension.
galopp-dreitakt.vorgreifen: In right canter, the right legs reach further forward.
galopp-dreitakt.links: In left canter, it's exactly the other way round: now the left legs reach further forward.
galopp-dreitakt.hand: In the arena, you canter on the right lead on the right rein, and on the left lead on the left rein.
galopp-dreitakt.merke: Remember: the canter has three beats and a moment of suspension. In right canter, the right legs reach further forward.

bahnfiguren.titel: School figures – how to ride in the arena.
bahnfiguren.bahn: An arena is often twenty by forty metres. There are letters around the edge, so everyone knows where they're riding.
bahnfiguren.ganze: Going large: you ride along all four sides and ride your corners properly. On the left rein, your left side is the inside.
bahnfiguren.wechsel: Changing the rein across the diagonal: you ride from F through X to H. After that, you're on the other rein.
bahnfiguren.zirkel: A circle is a large round figure at one short end. It is twenty metres across – as wide as the arena.
bahnfiguren.volte: A volte is a small circle. It is usually six, eight or ten metres across.
bahnfiguren.schlange: Serpentines: you ride even loops from one end of the arena to the other.
bahnfiguren.rund: For every figure: ride round, not square. And look with your eyes to where you want to go.
bahnfiguren.merke: Remember: with the letters, you can find your way in any arena.
